t: The Trebbia dual-lever mono mixer kitchen tap in chrome offers reliable performance and a modern aesthetic. Constructed from durable brass and finished in gloss chrome, with 1/4 turn operation and 1/2" ceramic disc valves for precise water flow and temperature control. Its deck-mounted design and practical swivel spout are ideal for busy kitchen environments. The replaceable Neoperl aerator and anti-limescale spout help maintain water quality and ease of maintenance, providing a long-lasting solution for any kitchen installation. Suitable for both high and low pressure systems, including gravity-fed setups.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
